conditions: Applies to the report’s dated SETL2 description.
limitations: The compilation ordering applies to units. The report permits multiple units per source file. Its mutually dependent example concerns the bodies after both specifications are compiled.

statement: Snyder’s SETL2 report requires compiling a package specification before the corresponding body and before other units that import that package. It describes compilation of the specification as invalidating the associated body and importing units, which then need recompilation.
